free_tier.stated: A free trial is attached to every term: 14 days on the 12-month and 6-month prepaid plans and 3 days on the 1-month plan, all reached through a billing redirect.

per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: The vendor's own marketing claims 3,200+ days; the r/usenet map records 550+ days for binaries and 5,800+ days for text on the same backbone. The conservative figure is recorded.

egress.terms: Unlimited Transfer and Unlimited Speed, 100 connections, SSL, VyprVPN included

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: Its only stacking value is the bundled VyprVPN; the 550-day binary spool makes it a poor primary beside any Omicron or Abavia plan.

limits.value: 550+ days for binaries against 5,800+ days for text, reported; the vendor markets 3,200+

limits_note: 1 month $9.99, 6 months $9.17/mo, 1 year $8.33/mo billed $100.00 against a stated $217.39 regular price. All terms include VyprVPN. The trial links point at order.giganews.com/signup/billing_redirect.html, which is a payment step.
binding_note: Binary depth is the constraint, not volume: unlimited transfer at 100 connections never runs out, but a 550-day binary spool cannot retrieve a 2019 post however much bandwidth is left.

identity_cost.detail: The trial is entered through a billing redirect, so a payment method is captured at the start. The vendor's own signup page describes the trial as starting from that billing step.

reliability_note: Own US and NL infrastructure on AS30094. The gap between the marketed 3,200 days and the mapped 550 days of binaries is the largest vendor-to-community disagreement.
confidence_note: Prices, connections and the trial length are vendor-stated and read today. Binary retention is third-party and contradicts the vendor's number, so the record keeps 550 days and sits at the reported rung.

evidence.proved: 1 Year $8.33/mo billed yearly at $100.00; 6 Months $9.17/mo; 1 Month $9.99/mo; '+ 14 days free trial' and '+ 3 days free trial'; 100 connections; unlimited transfer
Giganews backbone table: '550+ days (binaries), 5800+ days (text)' on both US and NL

notes: Where two sources disagree the record keeps the conservative number: 550 days of binaries, not the 3,200 the vendor advertises.

extras.retention_conflict: vendor 3,200 days vs mapped 550 days binaries
